description: Accept a proposed handoff. The accepted tasks are reassigned to the accepting participant, which is the point at which responsibility actually moves. Omitting accepted_task_ids accepts all of them. Accepting resolves the proposal for good: a later accept or decline on the same handoff answers -32051. A paused participant cannot accept and is refused with -32063.

accepted_task_ids.description: Which of the proposed tasks are being accepted. If omitted, all of them are.

comment.description: Anything the recipient wants recorded when taking the work on.

handoff_id.description: Identifier returned by chap.handoff.propose. A handoff already accepted or declined is refused with -32051.

name: chap.handoff.accept
title: Accept handoff
